title: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 02 Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support Posts
description: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhubaneswar (AIIMS Bhubaneswar) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 02 Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in postgraduation, M.Pharm, or any degree can grab this chance and apply for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts....
